name: genai
description: Rexial GenAI service (FastAPI) - RAG question generation and chat

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.build: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; exec "$PY" -m compileall -q app'
scripts.lint: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; exec "$PY" -m compileall -q app'
scripts.check-types: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; exec "$PY" -m compileall -q app'
